title: 3gqi.2.1: Python GNSS NMEA sentence generator for Renode injection
description: Implement a Python module that generates synthetic NMEA sentences (GGA, RMC, GSV) for a configurable position, time, and satellite constellation. No hardware needed — pure string formatting per NMEA 0183 spec. Used by Renode to inject GPS data into firmware UART. Include configurable fix quality (no fix, 2D, 3D), HDOP, speed, heading.
